secureboot.instructions_text:
SecureBoot is a UEFI security feature that prevents loading unsigned code at boot.

• To ENABLE SecureBoot: Reboot and access BIOS/UEFI (F2/F10/Del), then enable SecureBoot in security settings.

• To DISABLE SecureBoot: Same procedure, disable SecureBoot in BIOS/UEFI.

• To use custom kernels with SecureBoot enabled, you must sign kernel modules with your own MOK (Machine Owner Keys).

secureboot.import_key_details:
After import, you will need to:
1. Reboot the system
2. At boot, MOK Manager will open
3. Select 'Enroll MOK'
4. Enter the password you will define
5. Reboot again

Do you want to continue?

You will need to reboot and confirm in MOK Manager.
